excludeTitles: ^(Thanksgiving|Christmas( Eve| Day)?|New Year[’']s( Eve| Day)?|Veterans[’']? Day|Independence Day|Memorial Day|Labor Day|Martin Luther King.*|Presidents[’']? Day|Juneteenth|Columbus Day|Indigenous Peoples[’']? Day)( \(observed\))?$
sources.notes: Confirmed 20 October 2026 on the owner's delegation. CivicPlus. The registry's earlier feedUrl (/calendar/ical/calendar.ics, from the 11 October handoff) answers 404; the site's own iCalendar page lists six calendars, and catID 24 is the community one (Black Hawk Fall Festival, 24 October 11 am-3 pm; Black Hawk Halloween Celebration, 31 October 3-8 pm), alongside the City's holiday closures, which are excluded by title. catID 14 is federal holidays, 25 the City Council and 26 the Historic Preservation Commission (meetings, left out); 22 and 23 were empty. The all-calendar RSS (/RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=All-calendar.xml) carries only the near-term window. The feed's LOCATION field holds the event flyer's HTML and the city and ZIP, not a venue, so each item's venue is a guess the editor settles. robots.txt allows the reader (20 October 2026). robots: subscribe from 29 October 2026, the editor's call delegated by the owner: CivicPlus added `Disallow: /common/modules/icalendar/` to every site it hosts on 20-21 October, which the check now reads case-blind, and this feed is the one the site offers residents as a calendar subscription; one nightly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "CivicPlus's calendar feeds").
